

```{r}
install.packages("rpart")
install.packages("rpart.plot")
```

Load Packages
```{r}
library(sf) # vector data
library(terra) # raster data
library(here) # file path management
library(tidyverse)
library(rpart) # recursive partitioning and regression trees
library(rpart.plot) # plotting for rpart
library(tmap) # map making
```

Create Night Light Change raster
```{r}
NightLights2021_02_07_Tile5 <- rast("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif")

NightLights2021_02_07_Tile6 <- rast("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif")

NightLights2021_02_16_Tile5 <- rast("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif")

NightLights2021_02_16_Tile6 <- rast("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif")

NightLights2021_02_07 <- merge(NightLights2021_02_07_Tile5, NightLights2021_02_07_Tile6)

NightLights2021_02_16 <- merge(NightLights2021_02_16_Tile5, NightLights2021_02_16_Tile6)

NightLightChange <- abs(NightLights2021_02_07 - NightLights2021_02_16)
```

Reclassify night light change raster to binary
```{r}
#Anything more than or equal to 200 nW cm-2sr-1 change is 1, other is 0
NightLightChange <- NightLightChange >= 200

#Change all 0 values to NA
NightLightChange[NightLightChange < 1] <- NA
```

Vectorize blackout mask
```{r}
NightLightChangeVector <- as.polygons(NightLightChange, dissolve = TRUE, values = TRUE)

NightLightChangeVector <- st_as_sf(NightLightChangeVector)

NightLightChangeVector <- st_make_valid(NightLightChangeVector)
```


Crop
```{r}
#Create bounding box
bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -96.5, ymin = 29, xmax = -94.5, ymax = 30.5), crs = 'EPSG:3083')

# Change crs of NightLightChangeVector
NightLightChangeVector <- st_transform(NightLightChangeVector, crs = 'EPSG:3083')

NightLightCropped <- st_crop(NightLightChangeVector, bbox)
```

Identify areas within 200m of all highways
```{r}
# Read in buildings data
buildings <- st_read("data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg", layer = "gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1")

# Read in roads data
roads <- st_read("data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg", layer = "gis_osm_roads_free_1")
```


```{r}
#Create 200 m buffer around roads
roads_buffer_200m = st_buffer(roads, dist = 200)

roads_buffer_200m <- st_union(roads_buffer_200m)

#
```
